entities.name: Marguerite de la Sablière
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marguerite de la Sablière, was a French salonist and polymath, friend and patron of Jean de La Fontaine, was the wife of Antoine Rambouillet, sieur de la Sablière (1624–1679), a Protestant financier and poet entrusted with the administration of the royal estates, her maiden name being Marguerite Hessein.
